app.title: ((-)) biotimbre ((-))
app.loading_models_hint: First run downloads about 70 MB. Afterwards this is instant and works offline.

setup.heading: Choose a library
setup.explain: No library was given, so nothing has been created yet. Pick the directory this library should live in — an existing one to open it, an empty one to start it.
setup.name: Library name
setup.name_hint: Only used when the library does not have a name yet.
setup.no_path: Give a directory for the library.

field.biotimbre_id_help: Leave empty to allocate a new one. Give an existing ID to file this sample under the same biotimbre.
field.biotimbre_id_edit_help: Editing an item never allocates a new biotimbre. Give a different existing ID to move this sample to it.
field.biotimbre_label_help: Human-readable name for this sample's biotimbre. Shared by every item filed under the same biotimbre ID.
field.taxa_help: Comma-separated tags, e.g. insecta, orthoptera. Empty means unknown.
field.band_help: Filtering already applied to this sample. Leave a bound empty if it is open.
field.filter_type_help: Kind of filter used to apply the band, e.g. Butterworth.
field.filter_order_help: Order of the filter used to apply the band.
field.speed_help: Applied before embedding. Below 1 slows down, bringing ultrasound into a model's range; above 1 speeds up. The stored audio is never changed.
field.window_help: Where this sample sits inside the original recording, in seconds.

admin.heading: Library items
admin.delete_confirm: Delete item {item_id} ({taxa})? Its audio and embeddings are removed too.
admin.duplicate_warning: Byte-identical audio is already stored as item(s) {items}. Adding it again is allowed.
admin.joined_species: Filed under the biotimbre {species} already has ({biotimbre_id}).
admin.speed_change_warning: Changing the speed recomputes this item's embeddings.
admin.no_items: The library is empty. Add a sample to begin.
admin.trim_hint: Drag to keep only part of the recording.
admin.filter_hint: Filters the audio before it is stored (Butterworth). Leave both blank to store it unfiltered.
admin.model_limits: Dashed lines mark each model's frequency limit; content above them is not seen by that model.

share.import_hint: A .btz file someone sent you. You will see exactly what it would do, and can change any of it, before anything is added.
share.models_none: No embeddings in this bundle — they will be computed here.
share.trust_hint: Kept only where the model's settings match this library's, so they are comparable. Saves recomputing them.
share.compute: Compute what the bundle does not supply
share.compute_hint: Leaves nothing unsearchable. Turn off to import now and embed later with backfill.
share.duplicates_hint: The same audio, filed under a different biotimbre: two libraries disagree about which being it is.
share.species_hint: One species, one biotimbre. Keeping the sender's leaves two identities for one animal until they are merged.

search.heading: Find similar samples
search.upload: Choose a recording to search with
search.upload_hint: Up to {seconds} s is searched. For a longer file, pick a segment below.
search.query_optional: Optional: with no recording, the filters below search the library on their own.
search.segment_hint: Drag to choose at most {seconds} s. The spectrogram shows the whole file, including any content above hearing range.
search.filters_hint: Applied before scoring, so results are ranked within the filtered set.

filter.biotimbre_id_help: Full biotimbre UUID. Copy it from the item detail view or a result's tooltip.

search.speed_help: Speed the query audio is embedded at. Only items indexed at this same speed are searched.
search.filter_help: Filter the query audio before matching (Butterworth). Leave both blank for no filtering.
search.filter_order_help: Order of the Butterworth filter applied to the cutoffs above.
search.no_matches: No matches. Try relaxing the filters.
search.metadata_only: Matching items, newest first. Without a recording there is nothing to score, so these are not ranked.
search.query_speed_note: Matched using the query embedded at speed {speed}.
search.needs_segment: Longer than {seconds} s — choose a segment to search with.
search.no_query: Choose a recording to search with, or set a filter to search by metadata.
search.compare_hint: Play the query, then each result, to judge the match by ear.
search.marker_hint: The lighter band marks the window that produced the score.

map.heading: Where the results are from
map.pick_hint: One dot per result; click a dot to see which. Clicking anywhere else sets the location filter's centre.
map.library_hint: One dot per item. Click a dot to see which.

inat.obscured: iNaturalist hides this observation's location, so no coordinates were filled.
inat.reserved: All rights reserved by the recordist — check before storing or exporting it.
inat.needs_id: Not research grade: the identification may still change.
inat.ceiling: Compressed to about {khz} kHz, below {model}'s {limit} kHz — the upper band is gone, whatever the sample rate says.

error.query_too_long: This recording is {duration} s. Pick a segment of at most {max} s.
